python3\n\"\"\"轨迹校验器：轨迹点是否真的落在画面里的目标物体上？\n\n这是本项目一直缺失的一层验收。之前所有优化都在「让轨迹自身更平滑/更连续」，\n却从没验证过轨迹点与原片里真实物体的位置是否一致。\n\n方法（每元素独立，不依赖 cutout、不依赖 gt65 的 score）：\n  1. 用该元素的颜色/亮度特征在原片里做前景提取\n  2. 剔除明显不属于该元素的大连通域（白瓶形背景、绿幕）\n  3. 在轨迹点的邻域内找「最匹配的连通域」，量两者中心距离\n  4. 输出 median / max 偏移，以及「轨迹落在目标内」的比例\n\n判据：\n  offset_median <= 0.02*W (21px) 且 hit_rate >= 0.8  → OK\n  否则 TRACK_BAD\n\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport cv2\nimport numpy as np\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nGT = ROOT / \"data/sprite/shot003/verify/gt65.json\"\nV2 = ROOT / \"work/research/tracks_v2.json\"\nVIS = ROOT / \"work/research/visibility.json\"\nFR = ROOT / \"work/track_proto/frames\"\nOUT = ROOT / \"work/research/track_vs_pixels.json\"\n\n# 每个元素的像素特征（有意写得保守：宁可漏检也不要误检）\ndef feat_green_white(img):\n    b, g, r = img[..., 0].astype(int), img[..., 1].astype(int), img[..., 2].astype(int)\n    green = (g > 90) & (g > r + 20) & (g > b + 20)\n    white = (r > 195) & (g > 195) & (b > 195)\n    return ((green | white) * 255).astype(np.uint8)\n\ndef feat_green(img):\n    b, g, r = img[..., 0].astype(int), img[..., 1].astype(int), img[..., 2].astype(int)\n    m = (g > 80) & (g > r + 18) & (g > b + 18) & (g < 230)\n    return (m * 255).astype(np.uint8)\n\ndef feat_white_bright(img):\n    b, g, r = img[..., 0].astype(int), img[..., 1].astype(int), img[..., 2].astype(int)\n    m = (r > 150) & (g > 150) & (b > 150) & (np.abs(r - g) < 45) & (np.abs(g - b) < 45) & (np.abs(r - b) < 45)\n    return (m * 255).astype(np.uint8)\n\ndef feat_skin(img):\n    a = img.astype(np.int16)\n    b, g, r = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]\n    m = (r > 95) & (g > 40) & (b > 20) & (r > g) & (r > b) & (np.abs(r - g) > 15)\n    return (m.astype(np.uint8)) * 255\n\nFEAT = {\n    \"girl\": feat_skin,\n    \"bottle\": feat_green_white,\n    \"camera\": feat_green_white,\n    \"wristband\": feat_green,\n    \"keyboard\": feat_green_white,\n    \"cassette\": feat_green_white,\n    \"strips\": feat_white_bright,\n    \"char_S07\": feat_white_bright,\n    \"char_S10\": feat_white_bright,\n}\n\nMAX_AREA = 200000     # 超过这个面积的多半是背景/白瓶形\nMIN_AREA = 400\n\n\ndef candidates(img, fn, W, H):\n    m = fn(img)\n    m = cv2.morphologyEx(m, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, np.ones((5, 5), np.uint8))\n    m = cv2.morphologyEx(m, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((7, 7), np.uint8))\n    n, lab, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m, 8)\n    out = []\n    for i in range(1, n):\n        x, y, w, h, area = stats[i]\n        if area < MIN_AREA or area > MAX_AREA:\n            continue\n        if h > H * 0.75 or w > W * 0.75:   # 排除横贯画面的白瓶形/绿幕残留\n            continue\n        out.append({\"cx\": x + w / 2, \"cy\": y + h / 2, \"w\": w, \"h\": h, \"area\": int(area)})\n    return out\n\n\ndef main():\n    gt = json.loads(GT.read_text())\n    v2 = json.loads(V2.read_text())\n    vis = json.loads(VIS.read_text())[\"elements\"]\n    W, H = gt[\"src_size\"]\n\n    report = {\"thresholds\": {\"offset_median_px\": round(0.02 * W, 1),\n                             \"hit_rate\": 0.80},\n              \"elements\": {}}\n\n    for name, el in v2[\"elements\"].items():\n        fn = FEAT.get(name)\n        if fn is None:\n            continue\n        track = {}\n        if el.get(\"judged\"):\n            for seg in el[\"segments\"]:\n                for p in seg[\"per_frame\"]:\n                    track[p[\"f\"]] = p\n        judges = []\n        misses = 0\n        for f, p in sorted(track.items()):\n            img = cv2.imread(str(FR / f\"f{f + 1:03d}.png\"))\n            if img is None:\n                continue\n            px, py = p[\"u\"] * W, p[\"v\"] * H\n            bw, bh = p[\"w\"] * W, p[\"h\"] * H\n            cands = candidates(img, fn, W, H)\n            if not cands:\n                misses += 1\n                continue\n            # 只考虑尺寸量级接近的候选（0.3x ~ 3x）\n            sized = [c for c in cands\n                     if 0.3 <= c[\"w\"] / max(1, bw) <= 3.0 and 0.3 <= c[\"h\"] / max(1, bh) <= 3.0]\n            pool = sized if sized else cands\n            best = min(pool, key=lambda c: (c[\"cx\"] - px) ** 2 + (c[\"cy\"] - py) ** 2)\n            d = float(np.hypot(best[\"cx\"] - px, best[\"cy\"] - py))\n            # 「命中」= 轨迹点落在该候选的框内\n            hit = (abs(best[\"cx\"] - px) <= best[\"w\"] / 2 and abs(best[\"cy\"] - py) <= best[\"h\"] / 2)\n            judges.append({\"f\": f, \"offset\": round(d, 1), \"hit\": bool(hit),\n                           \"track\": [round(px, 1), round(py, 1)],\n                           \"pixel\": [round(best[\"cx\"], 1), round(best[\"cy\"], 1)],\n                           \"size_ratio\": round(best[\"w\"] / max(1, bw), 2)})\n\n        if judges:\n            offs = [j[\"offset\"] for j in judges]\n            hits = [j for j in judges if j[\"hit\"]]\n            med = float(np.median(offs))\n            mx = float(np.max(offs))\n            hr = len(hits) / len(judges)\n            ok = (med <= 0.02 * W) and (hr >= 0.80)\n            verdict = \"OK\" if ok else \"TRACK_BAD\"\n        else:\n            med = mx = None\n            hr = 0.0\n            verdict = \"NO_SIGNAL\"\n\n        report[\"elements\"][name] = {\n            \"judged\": bool(el.get(\"judged\")),\n            \"n_frames\": len(judges),\n            \"n_miss\": misses,\n            \"offset_median_px\": round(med, 1) if med is not None else None,\n            \"offset_max_px\": round(mx, 1) if mx is not None else None,\n            \"hit_rate\": round(hr, 3),\n            \"verdict\": verdict,\n            \"per_frame\": judges,\n        }\n\n    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))\n\n    print(f\"{'element':10s} {'帧':>4s} {'med偏移':>8s} {'max偏移':>8s} {'命中率':>6s}  判定\")\n    print(\"-\" * 58)\n    for k, r in report[\"elements\"].items():\n        med = f\"{r['offset_median_px']:.0f}px\" if r[\"offset_median_px\"] is not None else \"-\"\n        mx = f\"{r['offset_max_px']:.0f}px\" if r[\"offset_max_px\"] is not None else \"-\"\n        print(f\"{k:10s} {r['n_frames']:4d} {med:>8s} {mx:>8s} {r['hit_rate']*100:5.0f}%  {r['verdict']}\")\n\n    bad = [k for k, r in report[\"elements\"].items() if 我用你的原话验证了一下，这句话**说错了**\n\n你说得对，三联视频里女孩太小、文字轨迹不对。我重新查了，原因不是「素材不行」，而是**我在渲染时用错了尺寸语义**。这是我的实现错误，不是素材的问题。\n\n---\n\n## 一、女孩为什么这么小 —— 定量解释\n\n`girl` 的 `tracks_v2` 轨迹在 f30 给出 `w=0.217, h=0.235` → 屏上 **234×451 px**。\n我用肤色分割量真实人物：**248×458 px**。**bbox 是对的（差 5%）。**\n\n问题出在贴图：我把整张 `P01_green_soda_bottle_cutout.png` 的 **tight bbox（581×1355）** 缩放到 234×451。\n\n但那张 cutout 里，**人物只占其中 407×995 px**（肤色范围），其余是空白/瓶子。\n所以：\n```\n人物实际渲染高度 = 451 × 995/1355 = 331 px\n原片人物真实高度 = 458 px\n→ 只有 72%\n```\n\n**这就是「女孩这么小」的全部原因** —— 我把「cutout 画布」当成「人物 bbox」来缩放了。scale 错了 28%。\n\n正确做法：贴图时应该用 **cutout 内有内容的 tight bbox**（alpha>128 的实际包围盒），而不是我当前代码里 `load_tight()` 做的裁剪……等等，我确实做了 tight crop。让我再查。\n\n<｜DSML｜  invoke name=\"code_run\">\n<｜DSML｜  parameter name=\"code\" string=\"true\">cd
